Help-center excerpts:

[atm-cash-not-dispensed] ATM didn't give me my cash (effective 2025-01-01)
If an ATM took money from your account but didn't give you the cash, or gave you less than you asked for, you can dispute it.

## What to do

1. Note the ATM location, date and time, and keep any receipt.
2. Check the app. Sometimes the ATM reverses the withdrawal on its own within a few days, and the transaction disappears or shows a matching credit.
3. If it's still there once the withdrawal has posted, open a dispute in the app within 60 days. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Cash not

[atm-cash-not-dispensed] ATM didn't give me my cash (effective 2025-01-01)
within 60 days. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Cash not dispensed.

## What happens next

We ask the ATM operator for its records. Most ATM cases are resolved within 10 business days. If the records show the cash wasn't dispensed, we credit the full amount, including any ATM fee we charged for that withdrawal.

## Pending withdrawals

You can't dispute a withdrawal while it's still pending. Wait until it posts.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[atm-network] Finding a BrookLink ATM (effective 2025-01-01)
on your plan, and the ATM owner may add a surcharge. The ATM screen should show the owner's surcharge before you confirm.

## Daily limits

ATM withdrawals count toward a daily ATM limit that depends on your plan. See "ATM withdrawal limits".

## Depositing cash

BrookLink ATMs don't take cash deposits. To add cash, use a participating retail store instead. See "Depositing cash at a store".

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[fee-changes-2026] What changed in the March 2026 fee update (effective 2026-03-01)
2 to 3 a month.

## What stayed the same

Basic is still free. Premium is still $15.00 a month with no ATM or foreign transaction fees. Card replacement, wire and cash deposit fees didn't change on any plan.

## Why we made these changes

Out-of-network ATM operators raised what they charge us, and we moved part of that cost into the fee. We lowered the Plus foreign transaction fee at the same time, so Plus members who travel pay less overall.

If the new Plus price doesn't work for you, you can

[cash-deposit-retail] Depositing cash at a store (effective 2025-01-01)
|
| Premium | $2,000 |

## When the money arrives

Funds usually appear within minutes. Keep the store receipt until you see the deposit in the app.

## Things to know

- BrookLink ATMs don't accept cash deposits.
- The barcode is valid for one deposit only.
- Stores set their own maximum per visit, which can be lower than your daily limit.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[atm-surcharges] ATM owner surcharges and our fees (effective 2025-01-01)
When you use an ATM outside BrookLink, up to two different charges can apply. They're easy to mix up.

## The ATM owner's surcharge

This is set by whoever owns the ATM, not by us. The ATM shows it on screen before you confirm, and it's added to the withdrawal amount. For example, if you withdraw cash and the owner charges a surcharge, one transaction for the total appears in your activity.

## Tallowbrook's out-of-network fee

This is our fee, charged as a separate line called "Out-of-network ATM fee".

[atm-limits] ATM withdrawal limits (effective 2025-01-01)
How much cash you can take out each day depends on your plan. The limit covers all ATMs combined, in the US and abroad.

| Plan | Daily ATM limit |
|---|---|
| Basic | $500 |
| Plus | $1,000 |
| Premium | $1,500 |

The daily limit resets at midnight Eastern Time.

## Can I raise my limit?

No. Limits are set by plan, and support can't raise them for a day or make exceptions. The only way to get a higher limit is to change plan.

You are the help-center assistant for Tallowbrook, a US neobank. Answer the customer's question using only the help-center excerpts you are given.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
